verifications.claim: The 2026 The Players Championship is March 12–15.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Thu., March 12 ... Fri., March 13 ... Sat., March 14 ... Sun., March 15 (R1); Thursday, March 12 ... Sunday, March 15 (R7); March 12-15, 2026 (R10)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact dates March 12-15, 2026.

verifications.claim: Golf Channel provides early coverage on Thursday-Friday for the 2026 The Players Championship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The Golf Channel will have the main broadcast window on Thursday and Friday ... Round 1 broadcast 1-7 p.m. Golf Channel ... Round 2 broadcast 1-7 p.m. Golf Channel (R1); Golf Channel ... from 1-7 p.m. ET (R2); Golf Channel has coverage of the rest of the tourney (Thu-Fri implied, R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state Golf Channel covers Thursday-Friday main broadcast starting ~1 p.m. ET, positioned as early-week coverage before NBC weekend.

verifications.claim: NBC provides afternoon coverage on Saturday-Sunday for the 2026 The Players Championship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Round 3 broadcast 2-7 p.m. NBC ... Round 4 broadcast 1-6 p.m. NBC (R1); Round 3 coverage at 2 p.m. ET on Saturday ... Final Round coverage at 1 p.m. ET on Sunday (R3); TV coverage: 1-6 p.m. on NBC (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm NBC coverage starting 1-2 p.m. ET on Sat-Sun, matching 'afternoon'.

verifications.claim: Peacock simulcasts TV coverage for all four rounds of the 2026 The Players Championship.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: the portions broadcast on NBC will be available on Peacock (R1); NBC and Peacock ... begins with Round 3 ... Saturday, March 14, and Final Round ... Sunday, March 15 (R3); TV simulcast live stream: 1-6 p.m. on Peacock (Round 4, R4); streaming available on Peacock this weekend (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify Peacock simulcasts only NBC weekend coverage (Sat-Sun), not Golf Channel Thu-Fri or all four rounds.

verifications.claim: ESPN+ offers exclusive featured group coverage starting early morning for the 2026 The Players Championship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: ESPN+ will carry the main feed and coverage of featured groups and holes all four days ... 7:30 a.m. (R1); PGA Tour Live on ESPN+ ... starting ... at 7:30 a.m. ET, as well as featured group ... coverage (R2); Live streams: 7:30 a.m. ... Featured Groups (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state ESPN+ provides featured groups coverage from early morning (7:30 a.m.) all days.

verifications.claim: ESPN+ offers exclusive featured hole coverage of Nos. 3, 12, 16, 17 starting early morning for the 2026 The Players Championship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: coverage of featured groups and holes ... 7:30 a.m. (R1); featured group and featured hole coverage all day (R2); Live streams: 7:30 a.m. ... Featured Holes (Nos. 3, 12, 16, 17) (R4)
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly lists holes 3,12,16,17 on ESPN+/PGA Tour Live from 7:30 a.m.; others confirm featured holes early.
